Notes: Andre was marked safe from the unsend. Had to work real hard, but pulled it off again! Made an earlier belay at the end of the traverse on Kevin's advice, which was a really cool view back at the route as Tohomas climbed after me. Thomas fell unexpectedly part way through the traverse and took a pretty big pendulum fall and scraped up his back real good! From that belay I went all the way to the top of the headwall. On our way down we did a real rope stretcher rappel from the three bolt anchor. To help Thomas get off the rappel, he plugged a #3 jin a flake just above the rappel station. As soon as he put body weight on it, the whole flake blew and he landed right in my lap while the flake fell past us!! Wild day.
